name: Wakeshift
description: Wakes OpenClaw sessions when an app they watch through Wakeshift sends something. Messages arrive as outside information, never as the user.

issuer.description: The Wakeshift whose beacons the plugin trusts, e.g. https://app.wakeshift.ai (the installer sets it).

allowNetworkHooks.description: The user agreed to OpenClaw's hooks endpoint while the gateway listens beyond this computer (its bind isn't loopback): the hooks share its listener (the installer sets it, with WAKESHIFT_OPENCLAW_NETWORK_HOOKS=1).

heartbeatTarget.description: Unused: from the earlier heartbeat wake. A woken turn's reply now goes to the channel the conversation last spoke on.
